academicYears.title: Academic Years
academicYears.description: Manage the school's academic years and mark which one is current.
academicYears.emptyDescription: Create your first academic year to start setting up classes and timetables.

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: Split each academic year into terms or semesters.
terms.emptyDescription: Add terms to split each academic year into grading periods, like semesters or quarters.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Group subjects by department (e.g. Sciences, Humanities).
departments.emptyDescriptionSearch: Try a different name, or clear the search to see everyone.
departments.deleteConfirmDescription: This cannot be undone. Subjects linked to this department will lose their department reference.

departmentImport.title: Bulk Import Departments
departmentImport.description: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file following the template, paste rows directly into a grid, or upload your own file with different column names and match them up. Each department's code must be unique in Create mode; switch mode to update existing departments by code instead.

gradeLevels.title: Grade Levels
gradeLevels.description: Configure your school's grade/class levels (terminology like "Grade" vs "Class" is set in Settings).
gradeLevels.emptyDescription: Add grade levels to organize sections and classes by year.

gradeLevelImport.title: Bulk Import Grade Levels
gradeLevelImport.description: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file following the template. Each grade level's code must be unique; sequence determines promotion order.

sections.title: Sections
sections.description: Class sections for each grade level within an academic year.
sections.emptyDescription: Add sections to organize students within a grade level.

sectionImport.title: Bulk Import Sections
sectionImport.description: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file following the template. Sections are created in the current academic year. grade_level_code must match an existing grade level; room_code is optional. Assign a class teacher afterward from the section's own edit screen.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Subjects taught across the school, optionally grouped by department.
subjects.emptyDescriptionSearch: Try a different name, or clear the search to see everyone.

subjectImport.title: Bulk Import Subjects
subjectImport.description: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file following the template. Each subject's code must be unique. department_code is optional and must match an existing department's code.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Classrooms, labs, and halls available for sections and timetable scheduling.
rooms.emptyDescriptionSearch: Try a different name, or clear the search to see everyone.

roomImport.title: Bulk Import Rooms
roomImport.description: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file following the template. Each room's code must be unique. type is one of classroom, lab, hall, or other (defaults to classroom).

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.description: Public and school-specific holidays shown on the academic calendar.
holidays.emptyDescription: Add holidays to keep attendance and timetables accurate.

timetable.title: Timetable
timetable.description: Configure periods, assign teachers to subjects, and build each section's weekly schedule.

timetableGrid.selectSectionEmptyTitle: Select a section to view its timetable
timetableGrid.noPeriodsDescription: Add timetable periods in the Periods tab first.
timetableGrid.subjectTeacherHint: From this section's assigned subject-teacher pairs

timetablePeriods.emptyDescription: Add periods to build out the daily timetable structure for this school.
timetablePeriods.isBreakLabel: This is a break (not a teaching period)
timetablePeriods.deleteConfirmDescription: Any timetable entries using this period will also be removed.

classSubjectTeacher.emptyDescription: Assign teachers to subjects for this section.
